captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a single open-topped cubic pill compartment and a separate flat square lid. The container has two small rectangular clasp tabs protruding from the top edges of its opposing walls. The flat lid includes two corresponding rectangular notches cut into its edges to snap-fit onto these clasp tabs.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable pill organizer with a detachable lid in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to configure the number of days, weeks, whether to include an extra compartment, and whether to render text or braille on the lid.
captions.factory: The design uses a 'pill' module that constructs a hollow cube by subtracting a smaller cube from a 20mm outer cube, then adds two small clasp cubes on opposite top edges. The 'lid' module creates a flat cube with two small rectangular cutouts on its edges. Multi-compartment variations are generated using for-loops to translate and duplicate the pill boxes and lids based on 'Number_of_days' and 'Number_of_weeks' parameters. Text is conditionally added using the write module from an external library.
